cycle: Standard Time per Piece (in Sec) — filled in from the Part when picked, and can be changed for the day.
shift: Machine Shift Time (Hours) = Machine OFF Time − Machine ON Time
idealQty: Ideal Quantity = Machine Shift Time × 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece (shown to 2 decimals, as on the sheet). TOTAL QTY. may be more than this — such an entry goes to OEE Review (Performance above 100%).
rejectedQty: Rejected QTY = TOTAL QTY. − OK QTY.
pctOk: Ok Quantity (%) = OK QTY. ÷ TOTAL QTY.
unutilized: Unutilized Machine Time = (12 − (Shift Hours − Lunch ÷ 60)) ÷ 11, with Shift Hours and Lunch added up across every entry of this machine's date — so every entry of that machine/date shows the same figure. Shown as 0% when the result is below 0 and 100% when it is above 100.
totalStoppage: Total Idle Time (Min) = the ten downtime columns added up, Lunch / Tea / Washroom included.
effective: Effective Machine Run Time (hours) = TOTAL QTY. × Standard Time per Piece ÷ 3600 — every piece run counts on this sheet.
unreported: Unreported Time (min) = Planned Operator Shift × 60 − Effective Machine Run Time × 60 − Total Idle Time, for this entry. A Planned Operator Shift locked in Process Master counts once for the machine's day, so a locked day is combined across its entries.
setupEff: Setup Efficiency = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ Machine Shift Time
oeeLosses: OEE considering losses = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Total Idle Time ÷ 60), for this entry (combined across the machine's day on a locked shift).
oeeLunch: OEE not considering losses but lunch = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch ÷ 60), for this entry (combined across the machine's day on a locked shift).
oeeLunchCot: OEE not considering losses but lunch and COT = Effective Machine Run Time ÷ (Planned Operator Shift − Lunch ÷ 60 − Setup Time ÷ 60), for this entry (combined across the machine's day on a locked shift). COT = change-over time, the Setup Time column.
availability: Availability = Operating Time ÷ Planned Production Time, for this entry. Operating Time = Machine Shift − every stoppage; Planned Production Time = Planned Operator Shift − Lunch − Planned Down Time (the planned stops). Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review.
performance: Performance = Standard Time per Piece × TOTAL QTY. ÷ Operating Time, for this entry — how fast it ran against its ideal speed. Above 100% (red) sends the entry to Admin review: usually a wrong time per piece, quantity or downtime.
quality: Quality = OK Quantity ÷ (OK + Rejected), for this entry.
review: Admin review: an entry whose Availability, Performance, Quality or any of its OEE figures (the Productivity figures, on a worker sheet) is above 100% is held as Pending review until an Admin or Super Admin approves or rejects it. Editing the figures sends it back for review; hover for details.
totalQty: TOTAL QTY. = every piece the machine ran (OK + Rejected).
idealQtyPerHour: Ideal Quantity/Hour = 3600 ÷ Standard Time per Piece
